hero.title: Smart Hospital Management System.
hero.subtitle: HealthMS predicts your exact doctor consultation turn, syncs real-time queue tokens across multiple hospitals, and recognizes voluntary blood donors with priority family care.

landing.hospitalsSubtitle: 3 Premier Multi-Specialty Centers in National Capital Region
landing.donorTitle: Donate Blood. Save Lives. Protect Your Family.
landing.donorSubtitle: We honor 100% voluntary, unpaid blood donors with official milestone badges, thank-you certificates, and Donor Family Fast-Track benefits (waived processing fees & expedited paperwork) during clinical emergencies.
landing.featuresTitle: Engineered for Zero Waiting Time & Instant Emergency Response
landing.featuresSubtitle: Four architectural pillars designed to restore dignity to hospital visits and accelerate life-saving care.
landing.feat1Desc: Rolling average calculation (Tavg) ensures real-time ETA updates as consultations finish or overrun.
landing.feat2Desc: Computes dynamic departure alarms based on travel distance and check-in buffers so you never wait in hospital lounges.
landing.feat3Desc: Longitudinal EHR aggregating prescriptions, lab reports, AI summaries, and blood donation milestones.
landing.feat4Desc: Patient controls which doctor views what record, backed by cryptographic immutable access logs.
landing.osDesc: Connect your health journey with real-time OPD streaming, emergency triage break-glass protection, and the LifeShare voluntary donor family network.

footer.mission: Next-generation smart hospital management system designed to eliminate patient waiting queues and empower voluntary blood donors.
footer.ethicsDesc: LifeShare blood donation is strictly 100% voluntary and unpaid under National Blood Transfusion Council (NBTC) guidelines. Recognition badges and thank-you certificates carry zero monetary value. Donor Family Fast-Track waives administrative handling fees without ever overriding clinical urgency.
